## Synopsis

```text
Meziantou.Framework.Geo.Maps.Tool [command] [options]
```

## Description

Generates offline map bundles for Meziantou.Framework.Geo.Maps, from OpenStreetMap and Natural Earth.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-?`, `-h`, `--help` | Show help and usage information |
| `--version` | Show version information |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [build](02-Build.md) | Builds the bundles of regions |
| [pack](03-Pack.md) | Builds the bundles of regions, and a NuGet package per bundle: by default, an assembly built by the .NET SDK that embeds the map and opens it with Map.Region\_\<Key\> |
| [list](04-List.md) | Lists the regions: their identifier, their key (the name of their bundle), their ISO 3166-1 code and their continent |
| [update-pins](05-UpdatePins.md) | Downloads the latest versions of the sources, and pins them in a file to use with --pins |
